items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Terminology 40:1
items.html: The Sium of Atzilut is in the Bina of NHY of AK. For because of the ascent of the bottom Hey and her joining with the first Hey, the Bina and ZON of NHY of AK went outside Atzilut, and the place for BYA was made there, as is known. Therefore the Sium of Atzilut is regarded as being a little above the Sium of the legs of AK of the first restriction. (p. 607, Item 14)
